source_layers.scope: address, place status, public hours, geospatial

field_rules: Operational fields can be overridden by verified mosque admins but retain prior provenance/history.
Architecture/history fields are not automatically overridden by a mosque admin; disputed claims enter editorial review.
Provider-derived hours retain provider timestamp and cannot be relabeled as mosque-confirmed.
Every public field records source type, source ID, observed/verified date, confidence and claim-authority scope.
Shadow profiles must visibly show 'Unclaimed profile' or equivalent until claim completes.
